caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or blanket with a symmetrical design. The main background is an off-white or beige color. Along the top and bottom edges are narrow horizontal bands filled with small, alternating dotted and dash patterns in muted red, blue, and light brown. Near each corner, but set in from the edges, are identical stepped triangular motifs in a striped arrangement composed of red, blue, and gray tones, positioned to point toward the center of the textile. At the center of the rectangle, there is a large diamond shape, also executed in the same stepped pattern and color scheme as the corner motifs. Throughout the main field of the textile, small dash-like marks in blue and red are scattered at regular intervals. The entire textile is bordered by a faint, uneven hand-drawn outline, and there are two faint vertical lines dividing the textile design into halves, meeting at the center of the diamond motif. Some small, handwritten notations are present near the bottom edge of the drawing. The composition is geometric and repetitive, focusing on symmetry and the regular placement of motifs and marks.
title: Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
